english.note: This is the all-purpose technical label for a verb that does not take a direct object.

examples.english: In this sentence, “walk” is an intransitive verb and cannot be followed directly by an object.
examples.traditional: 呢個例句入面嘅「行」係不及物動詞，後面唔可以直接加賓語。
